text.topology.greywash.condition: Wind and tide expose a wreck road only while the flats drain.
text.topology.greywash.work: Greywash salts fish, tends broad pans, and recovers accountable wreck cargo.
text.topology.greywash.pressure: A broken tide chain will drown the salt road before the next working ebb.
text.topology.greywash.objective: Reach the upper chain house and secure two iron links or alter the sluice schedule.
text.topology.greywash.contact.1.name: Edda Marr
text.topology.greywash.contact.2.name: Colm Vey
text.topology.greenwold.condition: A shifting forest wind carries an illicit charcoal burn toward medicine coppice.
text.topology.greenwold.work: Greenwold cuts managed timber, burns charcoal, gathers resin, and tends healing plants.
text.topology.greenwold.pressure: The burn crew moved the water key into a root store while smoke thickens.
text.topology.greenwold.objective: Recover the water key below, rescue the wounded reeve, or redirect the burn shutters.
text.topology.greenwold.contact.1.name: Nera Holt
text.topology.greenwold.contact.2.name: Ivo Briar
text.topology.whitecairn.condition: Repeated quarry bells warn of a ridge cut that is becoming unstable.
text.topology.whitecairn.work: Whitecairn burns lime, cuts building stone, and moves wool over high switchbacks.
text.topology.whitecairn.pressure: A private toll crew is ringing false blasts while the real quarry face slips.
text.topology.whitecairn.objective: Reach the lower cave braces and secure lime wedges, or expose the false bell from above.
text.topology.whitecairn.contact.1.name: Pera Chalk
text.topology.whitecairn.contact.2.name: Olin Sward
text.topology.dunmire.condition: Peat and seasonal water shape Dunmire Peat Isles.
text.topology.dunmire.work: The workers send charcoal downstream but depend on timber.
text.topology.dunmire.pressure: Fen overtopping threatens the accountable stores.
text.topology.dunmire.objective: Recover two charcoal lots from the upper works or secure its material control.
text.topology.dunmire.contact.1.name: Yara Silt
text.topology.dunmire.contact.1.memory: The old flood left a {shortage} obligation at the raised store.
text.topology.dunmire.contact.2.name: Deren Wick
text.topology.dunmire.contact.2.memory: The old flood left a {shortage} obligation at the raised store.
text.topology.dunmire.process.stage_one: Water laps the drying piles; the raised circuit stays above the peat cut.
text.topology.dunmire.process.applied: Peat water overtops the old store bank. The raised circuit and buried drain remain.
text.topology.dunmire.process.controlled: You open the drying-bank spill. Peat water drains; the winter fuel account needs a new settlement.
text.topology.rillscar.condition: Ironstone and seasonal water shape Rillscar Iron Gorge.
text.topology.rillscar.work: The workers send ironwork downstream but depend on charcoal.
text.topology.rillscar.pressure: Tailrace fracture threatens the accountable stores.
text.topology.rillscar.objective: Recover two ironwork lots from the upper works or secure its material control.
text.topology.rillscar.contact.1.name: Halen Crag
text.topology.rillscar.contact.1.memory: The old flood left a {shortage} obligation at the raised store.
text.topology.rillscar.contact.2.name: Vessa Ore
text.topology.rillscar.contact.2.memory: The old flood left a {shortage} obligation at the raised store.
text.topology.rillscar.process.stage_one: The tailrace jars its timber support; two bridges give different approaches.
text.topology.rillscar.process.applied: The old tailrace piles bend: debris will fall in three actions. Both bridges remain.
text.topology.rillscar.process.controlled: You tension the tailrace brace. The warned supports hold, protecting both bridge approaches.
text.topology.marlbank.condition: Clay and seasonal water shape Marlbank Clay Terraces.
text.topology.marlbank.work: The workers send grain downstream but depend on timber.
text.topology.marlbank.pressure: Irrigation release threatens the accountable stores.
text.topology.marlbank.objective: Recover two grain lots from the upper works or secure its material control.
text.topology.marlbank.contact.1.name: Mera Loam
text.topology.marlbank.contact.1.memory: The old flood left a {shortage} obligation at the raised store.
text.topology.marlbank.contact.2.name: Odrin Kiln
text.topology.marlbank.contact.2.memory: The old flood left a {shortage} obligation at the raised store.
text.topology.marlbank.process.stage_one: Kiln steam dries the upper seed beds; the field release will soon be needed.
text.topology.marlbank.process.applied: The unattended charcoal bed flares beside the flood-mark store; smoke travels with the wind.
text.topology.marlbank.process.controlled: You send the kiln release along the seed ditch. Fire and smoke subside, but the firing loses heat.
text.topology.frostmere.condition: Gravel and seasonal water shape Frostmere Braided Estuary.
text.topology.frostmere.work: The workers send salt fish downstream but depend on wool.
text.topology.frostmere.pressure: Ice-channel breakup threatens the accountable stores.
text.topology.frostmere.objective: Recover two salt fish lots from the upper works or secure its material control.
text.topology.frostmere.contact.1.name: Sarin Rill
text.topology.frostmere.contact.1.memory: The old flood left a {shortage} obligation at the raised store.
text.topology.frostmere.contact.2.name: Brenna Floe
text.topology.frostmere.contact.2.memory: The old flood left a {shortage} obligation at the raised store.
text.topology.frostmere.process.stage_one: Ice plates knock against the net loft; pilots mark the sheltered channel.
text.topology.frostmere.process.applied: Shallow sheets gather by the abandoned net store; thaw and load now change footing.
text.topology.frostmere.process.controlled: You swing the ice boom clear of the net loft. Load can move safely under the marked sounding.
text.topology.frontier.process.held: The recorded material work holds; the alternate circuit remains available.

text.topology.landform.event.limit: The old tracks cross this ground, but no new creature arrives.
text.topology.landform.event.occupied: Something passes beyond the visible ground, without a safe approach.
text.topology.landform.event.none: A disturbed track fades before any creature takes it.
text.topology.landform.event.threat: A {actor} appears near {x},{y}; its {goal} can be observed or avoided.
text.topology.landform.traveller.existing: {traveller}'s previous route marks remain in this country.
text.topology.landform.traveller.unavailable: A traveller's call carries from beyond this crowded approach.
text.topology.landform.traveller.arrival: {traveller} takes a visible stand at {x},{y}; speak beside them with E for a route clue or one physical lot.
text.topology.landform.event.stonefall: The {landform} shifts at {x},{y}; stone falls in three actions.
text.topology.landform.event.stonefall.none: The ground sounds unstable, but no exposed footing takes a new fracture.
text.topology.landform.event.structure_fall: Loose stone warns of a fall inside the {structure} at {x},{y},z-1.
text.topology.landform.event.structure_fall.n: The lower stone grinds without opening another fracture.
text.topology.landform.traveller.none: No field traveller is present here.
text.topology.landform.traveller.clue.used: The traveller has already marked this route for your courier.
text.topology.landform.traveller.clue.result: {traveller} marks the {structure} at {x},{y},z+1 as a known destination; the intervening ground still needs exploration.
text.topology.landform.traveller.lot.used: This traveller has no second counted lot to sell.
text.topology.landform.traveller.lot.credit: One trade credit is needed for the physical lot.
text.topology.landform.traveller.lot.result: One credit buys a physical {commodity} lot; {placement}
text.topology.landform.traveller.lot.ground: the full pack leaves it on the ground beside you.
text.topology.landform.traveller.invalid: Ask for a route mark or buy one counted lot.
text.topology.landform.overlay.title: {traveller}
text.topology.landform.overlay.summary: The traveller has sounded {structure} and carries one {commodity} lot.
text.topology.landform.overlay.clue.label: Ask for the upper watch location
text.topology.landform.overlay.lot.label: Buy one physical {commodity} lot for one credit
text.topology.landform.overlay.lot.requiremen: one credit and an unsold lot
text.topology.discovery.reveal: A field trace resolves into {cache}: {clue}. The cache is now marked; E opens it on site.
text.topology.discovery.wayfinding: {courier} gains one Wayfinding from the first field discovery in {region}.
text.topology.landform.overlay.guidance: A. Mark the upper watch's location (once). B. Buy the physical lot for one trade credit (once). Either choice takes time; Escape leaves the conversation.
text.topology.navigation.route.position_chang: Your position no longer matches the planned route.
text.topology.navigation.route.next_missing: The next place is not part of the remembered route.
text.topology.navigation.route.unsafe: The next remembered place has become unsafe or blocked.
text.topology.navigation.route.step_failed: The planned step did not complete.
text.topology.navigation.route.new_danger: New visible danger interrupts route following.
text.topology.navigation.route.new_alert: A newly alerted actor interrupts route following.
text.topology.navigation.route.new_hazard: A new visible material hazard interrupts route following.
text.topology.navigation.route.load: The carried load changes its movement state.
text.topology.navigation.route.sound: A new sound away from the route interrupts travel.
